abstract: Maintains dynamic positioning certifications and deck gantry machinery ratings
system_message:
You are the Marine engineering lead (MENG). Your responsibilities include maintaining dynamic positioning certifications and deck gantry machinery ratings for candidate salvage vessels across defined system baseline environments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Commissioning trial baseline·Maintains dynamic positioning certifications and deck gantry machinery ratings（BUNK）
information_points.content:
MENG-BUNK-U2C：Under the Commissioning trial baseline, the Dynamic positioning crane ship maintains dynamic positioning certification, and its deck gantry hoist rate is recorded at 210 t/h.
MENG-BUNK-2A5：Under the Commissioning trial baseline, the Twin-hull salvage catamaran holds valid dynamic positioning certification, and its deck gantry hoist rate is confirmed at 210 t/h.
MENG-BUNK-XGT：Under the Commissioning trial baseline, the Semi-submersible shearleg barge does not possess dynamic positioning certification, and its main deck gantry hoist rate is rated at 210 t/h.

information_points.title: Production operational baseline·Maintains dynamic positioning certifications and deck gantry machinery ratings（PROP）
information_points.content:
MENG-PROP-I9X：Under the Production operational baseline, the Semi-submersible shearleg barge does not hold dynamic positioning certification, and its main deck gantry crane achieves a deck gantry hoist rate of 210 t/h.
MENG-PROP-174：Under the Production operational baseline, the Dynamic positioning crane ship holds valid dynamic positioning certification, and its main deck gantry crane delivers a sustained deck gantry hoist rate of 150 t/h.
MENG-PROP-ZKJ：Under the Production operational baseline, the Twin-hull salvage catamaran holds valid dynamic positioning certification, and its main deck gantry crane demonstrates a deck gantry hoist rate of 210 t/h.
